If I were going to try to make this more appropriate, I might do something like:

Name: Reasonable
Clan: Malkavian antitribu
Capacity: 2
Disciplines: DEM
Sabbat.
Reasonable cannot bleed.

As for my list of best Dem non-bleed cards:
Lunatic Eruption
Deny
Touch of Clarity
Wrong and Crosswise

I'd be inclined to play this build with The Hungry Coyote, Wrong and Crosswise getting played constantly, and hunting as needed.

If wanting to go with other annoying actions that aren't a complete joke, besides Restructure which is narrow, Sleep of Reason feels playable even if I haven't played it enough to know. Some would be inclined to drop Blessing of Chaos on this dude to be annoying, but I have never found BoC to be useful.
